body.name: Tattered Choker
body.description: A crude choker made by tying together scraps of leather and worn bandages. There is no sign of proper tailoring, and its shape is rough and awkward. It barely deserves to be called a choker, yet it holds a faint but undeniable magical presence.

body.description: A forefoot lined with rock-hard muscle and menacing claws. Its sheer weight can be felt just by holding it.

body.name: Thorn Shield
body.description: Forged in the heart of a cursed thicket where the blood of a fallen hero was spilled, this shield harbors his vengeful spirit, eager to right ancient wrongs with every calculated parry.
body.effect: Returns 5 true physical damage to the attacker on blocking an attack.
